WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.

2. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

3. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

7. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.

8. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
